description: Found in fz-k22.10 option-B spike. CallTargetSummary bakes in the assumption that one SelectedCallee at one callsite has exactly ONE resolvable ABI. True for a recursive callee (bounded convergence class -> canonical_activation_key recompute is the clean fix). NOT true for a non-recursive callee whose two joined observations are genuinely, permanently different ground specializations sharing one FunctionId -- e.g. one closure template captured with two different concrete predicates, or a shared generic bridge called once for Range and once for Map. Three attempts all fail: (1) fabricate a union activation -> corrupts closure arity (spurious extra reducer executable); (2) keep both as separate CallTargetSummary entries -> regresses the opaque_fn_value_join join-to-one guardrail AND grows unboundedly on ascent-transient noise (a still-converging recursive CALLER re-observing its non-recursive callee at different pre-settlement snapshots looks identical to two permanent targets); (3) deterministic least-Ty-id pick -> order-independent but still arbitrarily drops one of two BOTH-NEEDED specs (regresses fz_f98_range_map_converges + 5). NEEDS new machinery: a representation for N-live-non-recursive-ground-specs-of-one-FunctionId that is neither dispatch nor collapse. Distinguish permanent divergence from ascent-transient snapshots. FZ_K22_10_TRACE telemetry on the branch is shaped to drive this.
title: fz-k22: CallTargetSummary cannot represent one callsite with N live NON-recursive ground specializations of one FunctionId (not a dispatch edge, not a collapse)
